cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (formula-first): the surfactant system is only Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #3 - no second reinforcing anionic, no chelating/reset route. The explicit 'Tiefenreinigung' intent removes C1's settled moderate result but claims may not assign cleansing (3.2), and the anchor for strong requires a strong chassis or multiple reinforcing routes. Lean formula (little conditioning) is the counter-signal.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: explicit deep-cleansing intent; very lean conditioning means little offset to SLES

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led; Glycerin #5, Hydrolyzed Keratin #6 and Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #7 are light routes; no silicone, lipid or fatty alcohol.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: depositionLoad light (one guar, protein), persistence low, resetCapacity moderate-strong.

focusPrimary.rationale: Clarifying: name 'Shampoo Tiefenreinigung', 'Tiefenreinigendes Shampoo', 'entfernt wirksam Styling-Rückstände', 'Deep-Cleanse-System'; lean SLES/betaine formula with minimal deposition is compatible.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: cleansing only moderate; 'für die tägliche Anwendung geeignet'
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Dominant deep-cleansing claim in the name; formula compatible (lean, low deposition) -> clarifying.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: 'Glanz'/'Leichtigkeit' are outcomes of the same cleansing route (F2).

usageRole.rationale: Occasional_reset: explicit deep-cleansing product by the D1 lexicon ('Tiefenreinigung' in the product name). Note the frequent trigger is also met (explicit 'für die tägliche Anwendung geeignet' and cleansing not strong); §9 has no precedence rule, the specialist product-level trigger was chosen.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No sensitive/itchy scalp positioning; Menthol #9 cooling agent.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; Zinc Sulfate is not a recognized active.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable (C low). T4: W neighbor none; C neighbor moderate keeps coarse acceptable -> no flag.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-ORDINARY: 'entfernt überschüssiges Fett von Haar und Kopfhaut' describes the cleansing action of an 'alle Haartypen' product rather than oily-scalp positioning; under P0 a doubtful E2 oily claim does not create a target.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 moderate -> regular (equals normal bucket). I3: neighbor strong would give clarifying, not the expected regular -> no flag.
projection.deepCleanserRationale: D1 true ('Tiefenreinigung' in product name). D2 fails because cleansingStrength is moderate, not strong -> not_flagged; D3 raises review_reset_positioning_mismatch (rows assembled but blocked).

uncertainties: C1 vs §3.2: C1's moderate result is conditioned on 'no reset/deep-cleansing intent', so intent alone can apparently move an identical SLES/betaine formula to strong - contradicting 'claims may not assign cleansing'. Resolved formula-first (moderate), which produces D3. A lane reading C1 the other way gets strong -> D2 flagged -> clarifying intensity.
§9: usage triggers can be met simultaneously (occasional_reset by D1 name, frequent by explicit daily-use + not strong); no precedence rule. Chose occasional_reset.
§9 occasional_reset does not itself require cleansingStrength strong, unlike alternating; D2 does. Standard allows occasional_reset + moderate, which always yields D3.

E2 oily: 'überschüssiges Fett von Haar und Kopfhaut' names scalp and excess oil but as an action of a for-all-hair-types product. Standard does not distinguish action statements from positioning. Resolved ordinary under P0.
